Rethinking the education payment process in a post-COVID-19 world
With the UK & Ireland home to more than 400,000 international students who contribute over £20 billion to the economy, it is vital institutions do all they can to provide an optimal payment experience.
Join us on November 19th at 1:30 PM GMT for an exclusive UK & IE roadshow where we'll take a look at how education institutions can use payments to ease student enrolment during and after the COVID-19 pandemic through:
- Preferred Payment Options - Flexibility of Choice - Personalised Instalment Plans
Register here: https://more.flywire.com/virtual-roadshow-uk-ie-november-2020.html
If you can't make the live roadshow but would still like to view the content, please register, and we will share the recording.
